# MeasureWise

> Quality operations platform for Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs). Plan PDSA cycles, track UDS measures on SPC charts, and export HRSA-ready audit binders.

MeasureWise links quality improvement work to UDS scores, HRSA funding, and PCMH recognition. Built by Jessica R. Smith, BSN — an FQHC Quality Director.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and value proposition for FQHC quality teams.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Walkthrough of PDSA cycles, SPC charts, and audit binders.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Solo $149, Multi-Site $349, Network $699 — 14-day free trial on every plan.
- [About](/about): Founder story and mission.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Real FQHCs using MeasureWise to move UDS measures.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the MeasureWise team.
- [Status](/status): System uptime and incident history.
- [Security & Compliance](/security): TLS 1.2+, AES-256, aggregate UDS data only, no PHI stored.
- [AthenaOne Operations Manual](/manual): $197 one-time PDF — FQHC AthenaOne workflows, CPT codes, macros, SOPs.

## Features

- [Features](/features): One page covering PDSA cycles, UDS tracking, SPC charts, HRSA audit binder export, and PCMH Q-PASS evidence collection.
